verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I come to You with the weight of all my stress
You pick me up and You let me catch my breath

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Lord, You never condemn, never make a list of wrongs
In the light of Your goodness, all the fear I’ve known is gone

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I’m safe in Your arms, Your arms of love
I’m Safe in Your arms, Your arms of love

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
All of my heart, my hope, my trust is held
Safe in Your arms, Your arms of love
Safe in Your arms, Your arms of love

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You were there when there was nothing left
A spark of hope where I saw emptiness

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Somehow even in pieces, You restore me with your peace
In the driest of deserts, You’re a never ending stream

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
The only shadow I see
Is the shadow of Your wings
The shadow of Your wings

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
The only shelter I need
Is the shadow of Your wings
The shadow of Your wings
